title: Execute property checks in explicit process and container environments
goal: Add generative property checking and a ContainerRunner alternative so a check’s scope and execution environment are reproducible and can support audited claims.
scope: Implement CheckSpec.Property(harness,generator,oracle) with a documented executable contract for generator/oracle inputs, bounded execution, reproducible generator state and captured check outputs. Bind harness/generator/oracle versions and declared inputs to the Check version.

Implement ContainerRunner as a real CheckRunner alternative to ProcessRunner for suitable Command/Property checks. Use an explicitly selected local environment/image, record its identity in env, expose available capabilities and map unavailable runtime/start/sandbox failures to Error rather than Fail.

Run Baseline, Candidate and Control snapshots through both paths, preserving input/output/check/environment provenance. Give ClaimAuditor usable Property evidence for the verified scope; a bounded generator run must not turn an arbitrary universal statement into proof beyond the check’s scope.
acceptance: A real local property harness passes an appropriate candidate and fails a deliberate counterexample through AcceptanceAuthority; fixed generator inputs reproduce the run and identify the oracle/environment.

ProcessRunner and ContainerRunner execute the same applicable check through the real consumer, with different recorded environment identities. Missing container support or unsupported capability yields a typed Error/denial, never a claimed successful container run.
Changing a harness, generator, oracle or environment invalidates the matching evidence reference. Report audit accepts only a scope actually supported by the recorded Property check.
context: Authority: ymp-docs/self-organizing-team-domain-model.md, sections 3.2 (CheckSpec.Property), 3.6 (CheckRun), 5.1 (CheckRunner), A2/A6/A11 and R-9. Use the approved model with 811a872 semantics and the greenfield baseline in 0c61ff1 and §5.8 for experimental strategy boundaries. Other documents and existing names explain implementation facts only.

Greenfield: create this behavior in the new implementation. Paths below are PROPOSED target modules under the layout owned by W1-0001; only completed prerequisite tasks supply implementation. Prior source, APIs, fixtures and delivery claims are not a baseline.

Create proposed crates/ymp-runtime/src/checks/{property,container}.rs and corresponding CheckRunner wiring. W1-0009 supplies ProcessRunner/CheckRun/AcceptanceAuthority; W2-0001 supplies independent author/visibility. Choose and document a concrete local property harness and container execution mechanism.

Harness/generator/oracle/image/environment inputs are versioned and bounded. No ambient remote service or automatic installation is assumed; unavailable container capability yields explicit Error/denial. ProcessRunner/ContainerRunner are real interchangeable consumers, not labels.
Property support limits the scope of a claim to the actual check. Preserve immutable snapshots, hidden input separation and the shared evidence-applicability contract.

history.note: Plan new implementation from greenfield baseline 0c61ff1, preserving approved experimental mechanisms, reporting/evidence/recovery rules and explicit prerequisite boundaries.
